html: † [סַרְבָּל] n.[m.] prob. mantle (v. especially SACJPhil. xxvi (1899), 307 f., cf. AndrM 74*, with conj. as to orig. Pers. form; > trousers; NH; JAram. id., with both meanings, also shoes; Arabic سِرْبَالٌ mantle is loan-word Frä 47; Egyptian Arabic زربول shoe is Gk. loan-word according to VollersZMG li (1897), 298, cf. Krauss ii. 412);—pl. sf. סַרְבָּלֵיהוֹן Dn 3:21, 27.
